records.name: Kite and Key Society
records.summary: A Penn student society that trains students to give campus tours to visitors. Students apply, interview, and complete training before they become members.

schedule.text: Fall 2026 Training Class: application and interviews, then a training retreat and weekly workshops during the semester

first_step.basis: An application, interviews, and training come before membership.

notes: Run summary: all 20 directory entries read via the API; every one reads INACTIVE and none lists an event. The batch file itself lists an individual student address for IPDGA and an individual address for Langfitt, and the directory lists an individual address for International Student-Athletes; those should be removed from the batch.
